title: Authorization to Use and Disclose Protected Health Information

sections.content: This authorization does not include psychotherapy notes. Psychotherapy notes may be released only under a separate, specific authorization.

This information may include records of substance use disorder treatment protected by federal law (42 C.F.R. Part 2). Part 2 records shared under this authorization may not be used or disclosed in civil, criminal, administrative, or legislative proceedings against me unless I give separate written consent or a court order is issued.
